from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityData(BaseModel):
    """Extracted enrollment and degree data from one CDS document for a university."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the university")
    undergraduate_enrollment: int | None = Field(description="Total undergraduate enrollment count (Section B1)")
    bachelor_degrees_awarded: int | None = Field(description="Number of bachelor's degrees awarded (Section B3 or Section J)")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period or date this data covers")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_data: list[UniversityData]
